limitations: Offline David Desktop is a clearly labeled timing placeholder, not the selected Voice A and not a final performance.
Sentence/clause synthesis has less connected phrasing and emotional variation than a full human or final Voice A read.
The pronunciation aliases for OMERTÀ, OMR, RWA, NPC and RPG are practical scratch approximations; final pronunciation needs listening review.
Caption timing is accurate to measured small utterances, not individual spoken words.
No music or environmental sound is included in this scratch pass.
Automated timing, waveform and loudness checks do not replace listening review.
